You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:

In the chest X-ray depicted in Figure 4, a round, peripherally ramified opacity is observed near the left hilum. Given this finding, along with the hyperinflation and oligaemia of the left upper lobe, what is the most likely diagnosis for this asymptomatic patient, considering the possible differential diagnoses?  
A) Bronchogenic cyst  
B) Pulmonary tuberculosis  
C) Bronchial atresia  
D) Aspergillosis  
E) Lung tumor  
F) Arteriovenous malformation
